coverage_note: 00:58-03:27 garbled pre-recording chatter (mixed Farsi?); 42:13-47:57 and 57:14-1:02:12 most of Medi's Arabic is '[speaking Arabic]/[speaking foreign language]' - errors there reconstructed only from Amal's echo/chat (e.g. 43:51 'a month before' fix and 45:00 'فيه error' not recoverable); 59:09-1:00:16 dual drill answers lost. Names عمان/إيطالي/فرنسي not flagged. S4 skips: ما منظر (مع), بدول (بضل), بتألم (بتعلم); سنين self-fixed to سنان; الموعد الـ self-fixed at 49:45.

rows.medi_said: أنا حكيت لي على ختيجي إنه
rows.why: He told his fiancée, so the ending must be -ha (her), not -li (me); repeated at 05:50 as حكيت لك; her chat writes 7akaitla; not voiced.

rows.amal_said: How do you make قهوة two؟ ... No، it's feminine، so شو.
rows.why: Two of a noun is the dual ending, not tnain + singular; she prompted, he tried قهوين, she said feminine, he got قهوتين.

rows.medi_said: أنا دايمًا، اه، أحكي لك-- أحكي لها إنه هي
rows.why: Habitual present (dayman) needs b-; her chat writes ba7kilha; not voiced.

rows.medi_said: هي تشربي، اه، too much قهوة.
rows.why: He used the 'you (f)' form for 'she' and dropped b-; she recast بتشرب.
English filler inside an Arabic sentence; sheet: 'a lot / very / much | Kteer | كتير'; she recast with كتير.
He meant she laughed at HIM but echoed عليك (at you); her chat writes 3allayy; not voiced.
English 'tummy' with an Arabic ending (engine wrote توني); sheet: 'stomach / belly | Bâ6en | بطن'; she asked شو يعني طم؟ and he said بطني.
Present needs b- and بطن is masculine (bywajje3); her chat writes beywajje3; not voiced.

rows.medi_said: أنا كان لازم أمرنها في الصباح
rows.chat: ana kaan laazem tmarranet fi el-subu7 ma ru7et
rows.why: مرّن = train someone (here 'her'); he meant train himself (تمرّن); chat writes tmarranet; not voiced.
rows.english: I should have worked out in the morning

rows.amal_said: ما؟ I didn't go. مش you did-- you don't go.
rows.why: He used a present 'you (f)' form for 'I didn't go'; she said I didn't go, not you don't go; he fixed to ما رحت.

rows.medi_said: أنا بأكل نفس إشي أغلب من أيام.
rows.amal_said: نفس. What's the-- شو جمع إشي؟ ... أشياء، نفس الأشياء.
rows.chat: ana baakol nafs el-ashyaa2 a8lab el-ayyaam
rows.why: He needed the plural; she asked for the plural of إشي and gave نفس الأشياء.
rows.english: I eat the same things most days

rows.medi_said: أنا بأكل نفس إشي أغلب من أيام. / أنا بأكل نفس الأشياء أغلب أيام.
rows.why: a8lab + noun is idafa with el- on the last word, no min; she prompted أغلب شو؟ الأيام.

rows.medi_said: ما إله؟ ... What is ما إله؟
rows.amal_said: ما إله طعم. النعناع الناشف. ... إله، إلي، إلك، إله.
rows.chat: ma ilo ta3em = it doesn't have a taste
rows.right: ما إله طعم = it has no taste
rows.why: He did not know the expression ma ilo ta3em and asked; she explained it.

rows.right: تلاتة وعشرين تسعة ألفين ستة وعشرين
rows.why: He left the month out of the date; she asked تلاتة وعشرين شو؟ and supplied تسعة.

rows.medi_said: عشر دقائق إلا، إلا، إلا ثنتين-- اه، إلا ثلاث؟
rows.why: Clock time puts the hour first: talaate illa 3ashra; she said بالعكس twice.
He said twenty-to while meaning ten-to (2:50, he had said 2:52); she recast عشرة.
حذاء is masculine so it takes أسود; she let it pass. (حذاء is MSA; sheet has 'formal shoes | Kundara | كندرة'.)
غلط is the noun 'mistake'; a person who is wrong is غلطان (sheet: 'wrong (person) | 8al6aan | غلطان'); she only said شو؟ and moved on.

rows.medi_said: اه، أنا فكرت إنه الخفيف دبا started.
rows.why: خفيف = light, not fall; she asked خفيف or خريف and explained خفيف is light.

rows.medi_said: اه، أنا فكرت إنه الخفيف دبا started.
rows.amal_said: B. The first letter is B. ببدأ. So بدأ، yeah.
rows.why: He swapped the letters of بدا (daba); she told him the first letter is B.
He added a t- (form tsaa2al) to 'you ask me'; she recast بتسأليني and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: شنو آآآ أكل؟ ... شنو فطور عندك؟
rows.why: شنو is Gulf/Iraqi; Levantine is شو; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: آآآ لا ما، ما بحب، ما بحب فول.
rows.amal_said: No. لا. أنا ما بحب الفول كمان.
rows.why: Nouns in general statements take el- (A1: el-tuffaa7 zaaki); her reply used الفول; could be just her answer.
He meant 'I didn't understand' but used the 'you (f)' ending -ti; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: How long will you stay with me؟
rows.amal_said: With us or at our hotel، at ours.
rows.why: He read عنا as 'with me'; she corrected it to us/ours.
rows.english: how long will you stay with us

rows.why: After ra7 the verb is bare (no b-); she supplied أضل and he said أدول.

rows.amal_said: How do I make يوم to...
rows.why: Two days is the dual يومين, not number + plural; she prompted and he said يومين.

rows.medi_said: آآآ in a half آآآ in half hour more.
rows.amal_said: No. If I say كمان شوي what does it mean؟
rows.wrong: كمان نص ساعة = half hour more
rows.right: كمان نص ساعة = in half an hour
rows.why: He misread kamaan + time as 'more'; she said No and explained it means 'in / after'.
The polite phrase is law sama7ti; he says la (no) also in his English comment, so it is likely not the engine; she did not fix it.
She asked what انسينا means; he guessed مصيبة and نصيب; she gave نسيت / نسينا (didn't-know).

rows.amal_said: بدفع and مش مع. Which one؟
rows.chat: keef betfaddel tedfa3? / ana badfa3 cash
rows.why: Engine garbled it (أحدا ما); her echo shows he said adfa3 ma3; she gave بدفع, no مع, and he said بدفع.

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم أحكي مع مديرك. أنا لازم أشكي.
rows.why: She recast 'I must complain' as 'I want to complain' (lazem -> biddi); he repeated أنا بدي أشكي.

rows.amal_said: واحد. One. خلص. So you don't need say one.
rows.why: One + plural is wrong and 'one' is not needed with a singular noun; she said you don't need to say one; he said سألت موظف.

rows.amal_said: استنى شوي. You asked him a question or you asked something of him؟
rows.why: سأل = ask a question; asking for something is طلب; she asked which he meant and he said طلبت.
طلب takes من before the person; she asked من؟ and he added من.
A known employee needs el- after the preposition; she asked موظف or الموظف and he said الموظف.

rows.medi_said: اللي، آآآ آآآ جا، / الـ موافظ اللي يجي
rows.amal_said: Oh، في error here. موظف اللي what؟ ... So you don't need الـ اللي. No اللي then. ... لا خلاص إنه يجي.
rows.why: illi = 'the one that' and does not mean 'to'; she said no illi here (enno or nothing); first said at 35:16, fixed at 38:31.
rows.english: I asked the employee to come

rows.amal_said: To come. So it's not to came. So it's to come.
rows.chat: talabet min el-muwazzaf illi yiji u ynaddef
rows.why: After asking someone to do something the action is a bare present verb; she said it's to come not to came and he said يجي.
rows.proposed_rule: After asking/telling someone to do something, the action verb is a bare present, not past: talabet min el-muwazzaf yiji (not aja).

rows.why: abadan needs ma on the verb; she asked أبدًا شو؟ and he added ما.

rows.amal_said: ما. It's came. He never came. ... Came past.
rows.why: A finished past event needs the past; she said came, past; he said ما آجه.
Complaint about the stay is past; she said you didn't like and he said ما حبيت.

rows.amal_said: الأمريكي. ... The American food. الأكل الأمريكي.
rows.why: She echoed الأمريكي twice and he asked What?, so he likely said امريكي without el-; engine shows الأمريكي.

rows.medi_said: الـ، uh، أمي الـ- الوحيد أكل.
rows.amal_said: الأكل الوحيد، cuz وحيد is not adjective.
rows.chat: el-akel el-wa7eed illi dall kaan fool
rows.why: Adjective goes after the noun; she said الأكل الوحيد and he repeated it.

rows.amal_said: تذكرة. تذكرة، تذاكر. ... تذكرة is a ticket.
rows.why: He did not know تذاكر and asked; she gave تذكرة = ticket.

rows.medi_said: أنا عادةً أحجز الـ، uh، تزكر.
rows.why: Habitual present (3aadatan) needs b-; chat writes ba7jez; not voiced.

rows.amal_said: قبل السفر بشوي. ما في قريبًا من السفر، قريبًا سفر. Doesn't work. ... قريب من السفر.
rows.chat: ana ba2dar ashterihom 2areeb min yoam el-safra
rows.right: قريب من السفر / قبل السفر بشوي
rows.why: Engine lost his Arabic; her echo shows قريبًا سفر; she said it doesn't work, قريبًا is 'soon', use قريب من.
First word of idafa takes no el-; she recast موعد الدرس and he repeated it.
She added ykoon after lamma before the adjective; B8 says leaving it out after lamma is not strict, so this may not score.
rows.english: when the lesson time is early

rows.amal_said: موعد دكتور السنان. ... Doctor's dentist. So the ال is at the end.
rows.why: In a chain only the last noun takes el-; she said the ال is at the end.
He used a present b- form for 'it changed'; she said it changed and he said قيف (t8ayyar).

rows.amal_said: ساعة دايمًا feminine. So مش واحد، شو بتصير؟ ... الوحدة. لا.
rows.why: Clock time is feminine with el-; she said sa3a is always feminine; he said الواحدة للتنتين.

rows.medi_said: It's tazkara? It's ticket, isn't it?
rows.why: Asked for 'booking', he gave tazkara (ticket); she said that is ticket, and he then said 7ajaz.

rows.medi_said: على cabin. You guys say cabin?
rows.why: He asked how to say cabin; she gave بيت / شاليه (didn't-know).

rows.amal_said: So أخو مرت أخوي. إنت، إنت it's just بالعكس.
rows.why: Chain possession starts with the thing owned and only the last owner takes the ending; she said بالعكس and gave أخو مرت أخوي.

rows.medi_said: Passenger in Farsi is... I don't even remember it now.
rows.why: She quizzed driver/passenger; he could not recall; she supplied راكب and سواق.

rows.medi_said: so [speaking foreign language] Do you take turns? ...
rows.why: He asked how to say take turns (his try is lost in the transcript); she gave بالدور.
He asked how to say two hours away; she gave بعيد ساعتين; his try is lost in the transcript.

rows.medi_said: [speaking Arabic] ... It took me two hours to make this table.
rows.amal_said: So now أخلص just أعمل. ... أعمل or أخلص just one. Which one؟ ... أخلص.
rows.why: Per her echo he used both a3mal and a5alles; she said just one, أخلص; his Arabic is lost in the transcript.
rows.english: it took me two hours to finish this table
